title: Sign in
notes: In real tests the password comes from an environment variable.

title: Open the component without the frame
notes: The same component, no frame_locator needed.

title: A field id with $ in it
notes: Two ways: an attribute selector, or the $ escaped.

title: Change a field and wait for the server
code:
page.goto(base + "/psc/ps/EMPLOYEE/HRMS/c/ADMINISTER_WORKFORCE.JOB_DATA.GBL")
emplid = page.locator("[id='JOB_EMPLID$0']")
emplid.fill("KU0001")
emplid.press("Tab")                      # FieldChange runs when the field loses focus
expect(page.locator("#WAIT_win0")).to_be_hidden()
expect(page.locator("[id='PERSON_NAME_NAME$0']")).to_have_text("Betty Locher")
print(page.locator("[id='PERSON_NAME_NAME$0']").inner_text())

title: Save, read the message, close it
code:
page.goto(base + "/psc/ps/EMPLOYEE/HRMS/c/ADMINISTER_WORKFORCE.JOB_DATA.GBL")
page.locator("[id='#ICSave']").click()
expect(page.locator("#WAIT_win0")).to_be_hidden()
message = page.locator("#alertmsg")
expect(message).to_be_visible()
print(message.inner_text().strip())
page.locator("[id='#ICOK']").click()
expect(message).to_be_hidden()
print("closed")
notes: The message box's markup varies by version; the [id='#ICOK'] button is the constant.

title: Why #ICSave finds nothing
notes: CSS #ICSave means an id of ICSave; the button's id is #ICSave.

title: A helper for round trips, in a frame or not
code:
def settle(target):
    """Wait for a PIA round trip to finish (target: a page or a frame_locator)."""
    expect(target.locator("#WAIT_win0")).to_be_hidden(timeout=30000)

page.goto(base + "/psp/ps/EMPLOYEE/HRMS/c/ADMINISTER_WORKFORCE.JOB_DATA.GBL")
f = page.frame_locator("#ptifrmtgtframe")
f.locator("[id='JOB_EMPLID$0']").fill("KU0002")
f.locator("[id='JOB_EMPLID$0']").press("Tab")
settle(f)
print(f.locator("[id='PERSON_NAME_NAME$0']").inner_text())
